newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision acquires systems from Warburg.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision acquires systems from Warburg.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp said Thursday it had completed the final transaction in a series of purchases from Warburg, Pincus Investors LP for cable television systems serving about 420,000 customers.

Cablevision said it paid total consideration of about $190 million to acquire the interests in A-R Cable Services Inc, A-R Cable Partners, Cablevision of Newark and Cablevision of Framingham Holdings Inc that it did not already own.
The systems include properties in Cablevision's core metropolitan areas and "non-core" territories the company plans on divesting, it said.

Cablevision Systems is the nation's sixth largest operator of cable television systems, serving 2.9 million customers in 19 states, with major operations in Boston, Cleveland and the New York area, where Cablevision currently has 1.7 million customers.
